description: The account's saved views from the leads table — each a named set of filters the user already built (e.g. 'Roofers with a mobile number'). Returns each view's filter conditions in the exact shape query_leads and export_leads accept, so "export my Hot Leads view to Close" works without rebuilding the filters by hand.
name: list_views

filters.description: Pass straight to query_leads or export_leads.

title: List saved views
